steps.now: One last trip: the train to the Great Wall. Walk east from the 西直门 bus stop to 北京北站 and buy a ticket at the window (bring your passport).
steps.past: Bought a train ticket to the Great Wall at 北京北站.

steps.now: Take the train — 京张高铁 — from the board in the concourse to 八达岭长城.
steps.past: Rode the fast train to 八达岭.

steps.now: Climb the Wall east to the watchtower. The spirits are waiting.
steps.past: Climbed the Wall to the watchtower, with every spirit beside me.

title: A photo on the Wall
blurb: An old man climbing the Great Wall wants a photo to prove he made it to the top.
lead: An old man on the Great Wall is holding out his phone.

steps.now: The old man on the Wall wants a photo — count him in.
steps.past: Took the old man's photo on the Wall — he counted with me.
